messages:
mira (CS): Heads up — we're getting reports that a subset of new onboarders (EU region) saw failures when calling our webhook ack endpoint during onboarding. seeing retries and 502s. starting a quick thread to coordinate customer comms and mitigations.
alex (CS): ack, can you share list of affected tenants? I can start targeted outreach.
mira (CS): initial list attached in the internal tracker (link) — about 18 tenants in trial/onboarding flows, 5 high-touch. most errors between 03:45-04:10 UTC.
sam (Eng): oncall-bot flagged a transient routing bug on the processing tier — root cause likely a stale LB rule. we rolled a config patch at 04:20 and saw error rate drop. still validating replays.
oncall-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-2023-3543 -> webhook-ack-502s. severity: high. status: investigating.
sam (Eng): mitigation steps we did: patched LB rules, cleared stale connections, restarted onboarding worker pool v2. running a backfill for failed messages now. ETA for full replay: ~45m.
diego (Product): this touches trial activations — renewal risk for orgs currently onboarding. CS messaging should include status, ETA, and offer live office hours. also flag renewals team for any at-risk deals.
leah (Solutions): can we offer a guided onboarding session for the 5 high-touch accounts and a credit for the trial window? happy to host.
alex (CS): draft outreach for affected accounts (short):
```
Hi <Customer name>,
We detected a transient error impacting some onboarding steps between 03:45–04:10 UTC that may have caused your activation to fail. Our team has applied a fix and is reprocessing the backlog. Expected resolution for your account: within ~45 minutes.
If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min guided session to finish any remaining steps and review usage. We've also queued a trial extension credit while we complete validation.
We apologize for the interruption — please reply here if you want the guided session.
Best, Mira (Redwood CS)
```
mira (CS): that looks good, concise. add a one-line link to status page and a short note about data safety (no data loss).
alex (CS): updated draft: added status link + assurance.
sam (Eng): backlog replay is at 70% now, error tail nearly zero. pushing a small canary to ensure no regressions. will post final once at 100%.
diego (Product): also add a quick FAQ line for customers who hit duplicate events (what to expect).
leah (Solutions): I'll prep a calendar invite template for the guided session. alex, can you tag the 5 high-touch accounts so I can reach out?
alex (CS): tagging done, sending outbound in 10.
oncall-bot: incident update: status -> mitigation in progress. replay: 70%. next update in 20m.
sam (Eng): replay complete at 04:58 UTC, metrics look clean. root cause summary: an automated LB rule reconciliation failed to apply to a small subset of runtime hosts after a maintenance window, leaving stale routing entries for the onboarding worker pool. fix: reconciliation retry + patch, and we've added an alert to detect divergence in LB config.
mira (CS): final comm plan: 1) immediate personalized note to affected tenants with ETA + guided session offer + 1-week trial credit; 2) post incident summary to status.redwood.ai with RCA; 3) schedule office hours tomorrow for any follow-ups.
diego (Product): thanks — please include a short renewal-risk flag on accounts >$50k so AMs can proactively follow up.
alex (CS): outbound sent to all 18 tenants, mailbox bounces 0. 5 high-touch invites scheduled, 3 accepted.
leah (Solutions): guiding sessions booked for accepted ones.
mira (CS): wrapping up: will publish the short RCA to status page in 30m and follow up here with the link. thanks everyone. :thank_you:
